hook.h2: You do not have to earn a place in these pages
hook.text: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,
son: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,
hook.note: When His own asked how to pray, the Son did not give them a formula. He gave them a Father, and told them to say so out loud. Everything in this Bible follows from that one word. Come, hear your Father’s voice.

translationStatement: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™.

short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Tangkhul — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. Our Father's words in blue, the Son's in red, the Spirit's in purple. A complete 66-book Tangkhul Bible, paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Tangkhul Bible: khipāna matuikhala kaji nathumna theipaiwui, kapi kahai khare Bible chi hina. Ithumwui Avāwui tui chi khamayingana, Anaomayarawui tui chi hunga, kala Manglāwui tui chi hungrisina.

Zingkum shākha lāngda, hung mayek china Anaomayarana matui apam chi chitheihai. Kha ithumwui Avāna chili lāngda matui — hi Tangkhul Bible-li, verse 5,615-li tui 105,158 — kala aja rāshungda awui tui kachiva̱ chi shimkhurwui ming chankahaibing thada muk zik akhamāng eina kapihai. Ana khare eina matuichingda leihai; kha Bible akhanala khipam chi nathumli machitheilakranga.

Ahung-asak hi, tui chi khipāwuina kaji matakhakna, khipāna matui kaji matakhak sing maningmana. Ithumwui Avāwui tui chi, khipā khamorna ningtonglak eina phungda matui jilala, awuina leichingra; ana mahānglakrang tui chi ahung masāpaimana; chānpao chi muk zika eina leichingra.

Awui sākhangatha̱bingna kathada seihā sārakhala da khangahān tharan, Anaomayarana athumli seihā sāwui ngaraichā akha mamihaimana. Ana athumli Avā chi mi: “Ithumwui Avā, kazingramli khaleia, naming tharmathengmeiranu” (Matthew 6:9). Hi Bible-wui alungli khalei saikora chi, tui akhamāng chiwui eina samkaphangna. Ithumna “Abba! Ishavā!” da vaoshoka (Romans 8:15).

Ana nathumwui eina katāva̱ maleimana. Ana nathumli pa̱ngapāhaomana. Ana kazingramli khalei nathumwui Avāna, kala nathum awui khaluma naona. “avā” da tui chi nathumli ringphā makhangasakwui tui akha maningakha, hi Bible chi mataimeikapta nathumwui vangna: hi lairikna chitheiwui Avā chi, mi avā ngarā za̱kahaibingwui aka̱lā maningmana — Ana khare china, kazingramlila okathuilila khalei shimkhur kachiva̱wui aming hi awui eina samkaphangwui Avā chi hina.

Lairik kachiva̱ chi mangā hāngtui akha eina phoka, kala hāngmishap 1,354 na pākakhuia chili ngachonmi, kathema chili maningmana. Nana hi lairik khipāli mirakhala, chi miwui aming kapisangwui apam akha leira. Bible kashungmei chi — lairik 66, chapter 1,189, verse 31,085, khikha macho-haimimana.

Hebrew, Aramaic kala Greek angayung tuiwui eina shitsangkapai eina onkahaina; edition kachiva̱ hi Father's Heart Bible™ wui eina onkahaina. 6 x 9 inch, paperback kala hardcover, ahung kachiva̱ eina. Lemmet akha, phaningung khavai khuiwui ot akha, shimlui akha.
Tangkhul shimkhur kala church kachiva̱wui vang — Ukhrul-li, Manipur kala Nagaland kuikhamareili, kala okathuili apam kachiva̱li — athumna kachichāramtui eina Avāwui akhon chi shāranu.
Nawui Avā chi samphanglu. Awui kahāng shākhuilu. Awui malung chi nawui vangna.

Divine Voice Color: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE
A presentation page — a gift, and a keepsake worth handing on
Paperback and hardcover, 6 x 9, full color throughout

faq.q: Is the Tangkhul edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Tangkhul, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Tangkhul edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Tangkhul edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Tangkhul text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Tangkhul Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/nmf.
